name: Finance-Edit
prompt: Premium commercial game UI concept for an original modern Korean urban life simulation called Ian Growing. Modern dense pixel art, tired ordinary protagonist, dry humor about work, education, debt, investing. Practical civic design, charcoal ink, muted blue-grey, warm uncoated paper, desaturated jade and selective oxblood seal. Group related data, stepped pixel edges, aligned numerals, restrained ink rules, explicit focus states, readable Korean. Show one finished straight-on game frame. No logos, generic mobile decoration, excessive frames, fantasy or web dashboard. Change the statement hierarchy only. Group cash, debt and net worth; separate the large printed cash vignette and scrolling account entries. Standalone financial window on a city background. Single game screenshot ONLY. Do not make a moodboard or multiple screens.
